before.title: Lakshadweep Tour Packages From Kochi by Ship
before.primaryKeyword: lakshadweep tour packages from kochi by ship
before.contentHtml:
The main Lakshadweep tour package from Kochi by ship is the government's Samudram cruise: a 5-day, 4-night sailing where you sleep aboard and visit Kavaratti, Kalpeni and Minicoy by day. On the official tariff it costs 22,500 rupees per adult in Gold class and 30,500 in Diamond, as of July 2026. Every seat is booked online, and every tourist needs an entry permit.

This is a research guide built from the official Lakshadweep government and Samudram portals. We have not sailed the route ourselves, so every price here is quoted from the official source with its date, and figures the tourism operators disagree on are flagged rather than guessed.

Lakshadweep tour packages from Kochi by ship

There is really one ship-based package that starts from Kochi, and it is run by the government, not a private cruise line. It is called Samudram, operated by SPORTS, the Lakshadweep tourism body. You board a passenger ship in Kochi, sleep in a cabin on board for the nights, and step off onto a different island each day.

The other official Lakshadweep packages are island stays, where you fly or sail across and sleep on land:

  • Samudram (ship cruise): 5 days, 4 nights, nights spent aboard the ship. The subject of this guide.
  • Island-stay packages: Agatti, Kadmat, Kavaratti, Bangaram and Thinnakara, where you stay in a resort or tent and reach the island by flight or ship.

If you specifically want the "by ship" experience from Kochi, Samudram is the package. The rest are reached mainly by air.

Lakshadweep tour packages from Kochi price

The Samudram package has two classes, Diamond and Gold, and the price is fixed by the government rather than sold at a fluctuating market rate. These are the official per-person fares from the Samudram portal, as of July 2026:

ClassAdultChild (1 to 10)What it is
Diamond₹30,500₹22,000The higher cabin class on M.V. Kavaratti
Gold₹22,500₹17,000The lower-priced package class

December sailings cost 10 percent more, the one seasonal surcharge on the official tariff. If you have seen prices like 42,500 or 44,625 rupees quoted online, those are not the government fare; they are private operator packages that add flights or agent margins. Always confirm the current figure on the official Samudram portal before you book, because prices and rules change.

Price for family and child fares

The child fare applies to children aged 1 to 10 years, confirmed on the official Lakshadweep government package page. A child in that band pays 22,000 rupees in Diamond class or 17,000 in Gold, and anyone 11 or older pays the adult fare. There is no separate official "family package," just the per-person tariff added up.

For a family of two adults and two children aged 1 to 10, that works out at:

Class2 adults + 2 children
Gold₹22,500 x 2 + ₹17,000 x 2 = ₹79,000
Diamond₹30,500 x 2 + ₹22,000 x 2 = ₹1,05,000

Add 10 percent for a December sailing. Those totals are the package fare only; treat any all-inclusive figure an agent quotes as separate from the government tariff.

What the Samudram package includes

The Samudram cruise is a 5-day, 4-night round trip from Kochi on M.V. Kavaratti, which carries about 150 Diamond-class berths. You sleep on the ship and visit three islands by day: Kavaratti, Kalpeni and Minicoy, with lunch and a welcome drink served ashore.

The official fare page does not print an itemised inclusions list, but the tour operators who sell the package consistently describe it as covering the following. Confirm each on the official portal before you rely on it:

  • Cabin berth for four nights in your chosen class
  • All meals on board, three a day plus morning and evening tea or coffee
  • The tourist entry permit and heritage fees
  • Day visits ashore with lunch, and a welcome drink on the island
  • Water sports such as kayaking, snorkelling and a glass-bottom boat ride

Our honest recommendation: Gold class is the sensible pick for most travellers. You are off the ship and on the islands every day, and asleep the rest of the time, so the 8,000-rupee jump to Diamond buys you a nicer cabin you barely use. Put that money into the trip instead.

Kochi to Lakshadweep ship time and fare

The sea crossing from Kochi to the Lakshadweep islands takes roughly 14 to 20 hours depending on the island, with Kavaratti around 18 to 20 hours. The Samudram cruise builds this into its 5-day schedule, so the overnight sailing is your first and last night aboard.

Boarding is at the Lakshadweep Wharf on Willingdon Island, Kochi, near the Food Corporation of India godown. Reporting time is early morning, around 9:00 to 9:30 AM for an afternoon departure, though sources differ on the exact time, so go by what your confirmed ticket says. The cruise runs multiple times a month in season, roughly October to mid-May, with the monsoon months off. The government usually announces exact sailing dates only one to two weeks ahead, so there is no year-round fixed calendar to book against.

The Samudram package fare is not the same as a plain point-to-point ship ticket. If you only want the ferry fare between Kochi and a single island rather than the cruise, see our guide to the Kochi to Lakshadweep ship ticket price.

The cheapest way from Kochi to Lakshadweep by ship

The cheapest Samudram package option is Gold class at 22,500 rupees per adult, which is the lowest official cruise fare. There is no discount code or dynamic "rate today" on it; the tariff is set by the government and changes only with the December surcharge or an official revision.

If your goal is simply the lowest fare to reach an island, and not the guided cruise, a plain point-to-point passenger-ship ticket in bunk class is far cheaper than any package, in the few-hundred-rupees range on the last published revision. That is a different product with no itinerary, meals or guided island visits, and it books through a separate official portal. We cover those fares and how they work in the ship ticket price guide.

How to book and the entry permit

The Samudram package is booked online only, through the official portal samudram.utl.gov.in. There is no walk-in counter sale for the cruise, and the government states plainly that booking is through the online system. Book early in the season, because the ship has limited berths and dates are released close in.

Every non-islander needs a Lakshadweep entry permit, which is a legal requirement under the islands' entry rules, not an optional extra. For package tourists the permit is handled through the booking and issued within about seven days of the journey, and the older police-clearance and sponsorship requirements no longer apply to tourists. You will need a confirmed booking and a valid government photo ID; foreign visitors also need a passport and an Indian tourist visa. Apply or check permit rules at epermit.utl.gov.in.

For a step-by-step of the ticketing portals and the online process, see our guide to Lakshadweep ship ticket online booking.

Lakshadweep tour package from Kochi by flight

If you would rather fly than sail, there is a flight from Kochi to Agatti, the only airport in Lakshadweep, taking about an hour. Alliance Air and Fly91 operate the route on small turboprop aircraft, with one-way fares that run from around 4,000 to 6,000 rupees and vary by date, since these are market airline prices rather than a fixed tariff.

Flying still requires the same Lakshadweep entry permit as sailing, and from Agatti you transfer to your island by boat. A flight-based trip pairs naturally with an island-stay package rather than the Samudram cruise. For the airline details and fares, see our guide to the Kochi to Lakshadweep flight ticket price.

Frequently asked questions

What is the price of a Lakshadweep tour package from Kochi by ship?

The official Samudram cruise fare is 22,500 rupees per adult in Gold class and 30,500 in Diamond, with child fares of 17,000 and 22,000 for ages 1 to 10, as of July 2026 on the Samudram portal. December sailings cost 10 percent more. Confirm the current price before booking.

How many days is the Samudram Lakshadweep package?

Five days and four nights. You board at Kochi, sleep aboard M.V. Kavaratti for the nights, and visit Kavaratti, Kalpeni and Minicoy islands by day, with lunch and a welcome drink served ashore. It is a round trip back to Kochi.

How long does the ship take from Kochi to Lakshadweep?

Roughly 14 to 20 hours depending on the island, with Kavaratti about 18 to 20 hours. The Samudram cruise absorbs the overnight crossings into its 5-day schedule, so you sail out on the first night and back on the last.

How do I book the Lakshadweep ship package and do I need a permit?

Book online through the official portal samudram.utl.gov.in, which is the only way to buy the cruise. Every non-islander needs a Lakshadweep entry permit, a legal requirement handled through the package booking and issued within about seven days of travel.

What is the cheapest Lakshadweep package from Kochi by ship?

Gold class on the Samudram cruise at 22,500 rupees per adult is the cheapest package fare. A plain point-to-point ship ticket in bunk class is cheaper still but is not a package, with no itinerary, meals or guided island visits.

Can I take children on the Samudram cruise?

Yes. Children aged 1 to 10 pay the child fare of 17,000 rupees in Gold class or 22,000 in Diamond, confirmed on the official government package page. Children aged 11 and above pay the adult fare. Each child still needs an entry permit.

Sources

  • Samudram cruise official tariff and booking, samudram.utl.gov.in, prices accessed July 2026
  • Lakshadweep Administration, tourist packages (duration, ship, islands, child age band)
  • Lakshadweep entry permit rules, epermit.utl.gov.in
  • Official passenger-ship e-ticketing portal, lakshadweep.irctc.co.in
  • Cover photograph of M.V. Kavaratti at Kochi by Aswin Krishna Poyil, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0

Prices and rules are quoted from the official portals as of July 2026 and change without notice. Confirm the current fare, sailing dates and permit requirements on the official Samudram and Lakshadweep government sites before you book or travel.

before.reasoning: Recovers the pruned/lost slug lakshadweep-tour-packages-from-kochi, which earned 1,171 lifetime views before the WordPress migration lost the row and is now a 404; reusing the evergreen slug exactly recovers its equity with no 301 needed. Fills a genuine catalogue gap: the site has eight live Lakshadweep pages but none targets the tour-package/Samudram-cruise intent (keyword volumes: kochi lakshadweep tour packages 1900, lakshadweep tour packages from kochi 1900, 100% keyword overlap). To avoid cannibalising the existing kochi-to-lakshadweep-ship-ticket-price (the site's biggest page ever) and lakshadweep-ship-ticket-online-booking, this page owns the package/itinerary intent and cross-links out for the point-to-point fare tables, the booking walkthrough and the flight option rather than duplicating them. Every price was verified against the official Samudram portal, not the AI Overview: samudram.utl.gov.in/faretable.aspx (accessed July 2026) gives Diamond 30,500 adult / 22,000 child and Gold 22,500 adult / 17,000 child, plus a 10% December surcharge. Critically, the Google AI Overview's upper figure of 44,625 and a widely-copied 42,500/12,500 set are NOT on the official tariff and were excluded as likely operator or LTC-specific numbers; publishing them would have repeated the fabricated-price pattern that got the site penalised. Verified facts: 5 days/4 nights on M.V. Kavaratti (Corals and Lagoon are point-to-point ships, not Samudram, so excluded), islands Kavaratti/Kalpeni/Minicoy, child band 1 to 10 years (official), booking online-only via samudram.utl.gov.in, and the mandatory entry permit per epermit.utl.gov.in. Hedged as unconfirmed: the inclusions list (operators agree but the official fare page does not itemise it), the ~9:00-9:30 AM Kochi reporting time (sources conflict), the ~14-20 hour crossing (no single official figure), and the point-to-point and flight fares (official portals JS-rendered/would not load), each pointed to the official source with a confirm-before-booking line per the YMYL track. No forbidden schema (no Product/Offer/Price/Review markup). Every H2 maps to a real Google query from the user's SERP screenshots (price, price for family, ship time and fare, cheapest, booking, by flight). Cover is the actual M.V. Kavaratti ship at Kochi; inline is Kalpeni, an island on the itinerary.
